entities.name: Baris
entities.description: A Serra Inquisitor on Ulgrotha around the time of the Homelands, a devout shepherd and judge of the people of Aysen.

entities.name: Serra Inquisitors
entities.description: An institution of Aysen society tasked with protecting the populace from harm and vice, whose methods sometimes became zealous persecution.

entities.name: Serra
entities.description: The divine figure whose tenets the Inquisitors uphold.

entities.name: Aysen
entities.description: The land whose people Baris shepherded as an Inquisitor.

entities.name: Ulgrotha
entities.description: The plane on which Baris lived.

entities.name: Beast Walkers
entities.description: People of dual human and beast nature, whose hearts Baris held to be aligned with Serra.

entities.name: Ihsan
entities.description: A fallen figure among the Serra Paladins, regarded by Baris with shame.

entities.name: Serra Paladins
entities.description: An order of Serra's followers, of which Ihsan was once a member.

entities.name: Death Speakers
entities.description: A group targeted by the Inquisitors' witch-hunt for practicing forbidden knowledge.
